summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed Form 6-K announcing a routine extension of a time charter contract for its Panamax vessel m/v Leto with Cargill International SA. The new charter rate increases from $12,750 to $18,000 per day gross, with a 4.75% commission, for a period running until September-October 2027. The filing is a standard operational update for a shipping company, not a special situation. It contains no M&A, capital markets, or restructuring activity. The only notable terms are the charter rate and duration, which are ordinary course of business. There is no strategic event, board action, or risk-arbitrage angle to monitor.
